description: Starts a browser, Electron app or mobile app session (closes the active one unless onExisting: "keep"). Browsers run headless at 1280x800 by default; pass navigationUrl to open a page right away. attach: true connects to a running Chrome via CDP.

app.description: Cloud app URL from upload_app (bs://, storage:filename=, lt://, tb://, cloud:<name>)

appWaitActivity.description: Android launch activity to wait for

attach.description: Attach to a running Chrome (attachConfig, default localhost:9222)

deviceName.description: Mobile: device, emulator or simulator name (required)

electronDeeplinkScheme.description: Electron: URI scheme (no ":") allowed for trigger_electron_deeplink

electronRootDir.description: Electron: project root for Builder/Forge discovery

name.description: Name for this session, unique among live sessions. Target it from other tools with session: <name>.

networkLogs.description: Local Chromium performance log capture (default from WDIO_MCP_NETWORK_LOGS or "none")

onExisting.description: close (default) replaces the active session. keep is an explicit opt-in to run this session alongside the existing ones; the new session is NOT made the default when one exists, so target it with session: <name>.

os.description: Cloud browser OS, provider-native, passed as-is: BrowserStack "OS X"/"Windows", Sauce Labs and TestMu "macOS"/"Windows", TestingBot "SEQUOIA"/"WIN11"

osVersion.description: Cloud browser OS version, provider-native: BrowserStack and TestMu "Sequoia", Sauce Labs "15", Windows "11"; omit for TestingBot

provider.description: Default local. Cloud providers read credentials from env. external: a W3C WebDriver endpoint (webdriverConfig).

trace.description: Save a Playwright-compatible trace zip to .trace/ on close_session

tunnel.description: Cloud: true starts a tunnel, "external" uses a running one

name: start_session
